parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays targeting human lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target name and organism. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require SMILES. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1 and organism for Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
